basic_details.short_information: Meghalaya Public Service Commission (MPSC), Shillong, has invited applications for 18 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. 02/2026-2027. The posts include Stenographer Grade III - Office of the Director General of Police Meghalaya, Shillong, Stenographer Grade III - Directorate of Sports and Youth Affairs, Meghalaya, Shillong, Stenographer Grade III - Directorate of Soil and Water Conservation Department, Meghalaya, Shillong, Stenographer Grade III - Meghalaya Administrative Training Institute and 4 more. Applications are accepted online until 26 December 2026.

content_sections.text: Screening Test Personal Interview Screening Test as per syllabus uploaded on the MPSC website Ratio from Screening Test to Personal Interview as per Commission's decision dated 13 April 2023 Only candidates who pass the Screening Test / Main examination are eligible for Personal Interview Only candidates who produce all required documents in original are called for Personal Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPSC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only online by clicking the Online Application icon on the MPSC website. First-time applicants must complete a one-time registration. Already registered candidates may log in and apply directly. Pay the fee by e-Challan or online through the GRAS gateway. Applications by any other mode will be summarily rejected. Apply before 17:00 hrs on 26 December 2026.
